description: Wazuh alert fields an attacker can influence (doc 6.5). Each is copied into state.untrusted under `key`, in this order, cut to max_chars_per_field and to max_chars_total over all values. A field is taken when it is in `default` or in the list of the alert's decoder.name. Fields listed nowhere are not sent to Jev at all: state.alert only carries a fixed set of rule and agent fields.
